mapper.select: SELECT p.permission_code FROM user_permissions up JOIN permissions p ON p.id = up.permission_id WHERE up.user_sub = #{userSub} AND up.is_active = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0
SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT p.permission_code, p.description, CASE WHEN up.user_sub IS NULL THEN 'NEVER_GRANTED' WHEN up.is_active = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS state, up.granted_by, up.created_at FROM permissions p LEFT JOIN user_permissions up ON up.permission_id = p.id AND up.user_sub = #{userSub} WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id
